review_method: User-confirmed non-clinician reference labeling, AI-assisted source review
reference_date_policy: Historical snapshot (2021-11-30); explicit temporal windows and qualifiers respected
on_therapy_policy: A documented active prescribed regimen can support unwindowed on-therapy wording; actual use/administration windows require direct use evidence
pregnancy_screening_policy: Synthetic, non-clinical demographic proxy only for E02 pregnancy/lactation-only exclusion; broader reproductive planning requires separate evidence

labels.criterion_text: Ability to confirm voluntary participation and agree to all trial purposes by signing and dating the consent form;
labels.reason: No record establishes that the patient voluntarily consented to this specific trial and signed and dated its consent form.
missing_information: Trial-specific signed and dated informed consent confirming voluntary participation.
labels.review_notes: Consent cannot be inferred from unrelated prior health-care encounters.

labels.criterion_text: Diagnosis of type II diabetes mellitus, and who did not reach the therapeutic goal of HbA1c with previous dietary, physical exercise, and previous therapies at stable doses within 3 months.
labels.reason: A confirmed type 2 diabetes-associated diagnosis, 2021-02-07 HbA1c of 6.12%, and an active metformin order are documented. However, the protocol-specific HbA1c therapeutic goal, prior failure to meet that goal despite diet/exercise, and stable treatment doses over the specified three-month period are not established.
missing_information: The trial-defined HbA1c goal and evidence it was unmet.
Documented diet, exercise and prior therapeutic interventions.
Treatment dose stability for the required three-month window.
labels.review_notes: Do not substitute a general diabetes HbA1c target for a trial-specific one. Active medication request does not establish three-month dose stability or adherence.

labels.criterion_text: Any clinical and laboratory findings that, in the judgment of the investigator, may interfere with the safety of participants;
labels.reason: The criterion explicitly requires the investigator to judge that clinical or laboratory findings may interfere with participant safety. Available records do not contain this trial-specific safety determination.
missing_information: Investigator assessment of clinical and laboratory findings for participation safety.
labels.review_notes: Neither routine medical diagnoses nor normal-appearing values can replace investigator judgment.

labels.criterion_text: History of alcohol abuse or illicit drug use;
labels.reason: Several historical drug-abuse screening procedures and AUDIT-C scores are recorded, including AUDIT-C 2 in 2021. Neither the existence of a screening procedure nor a low questionnaire score proves or excludes a lifetime history of alcohol abuse or illicit drug use.
missing_information: An explicit positive or sufficiently scoped negative history of alcohol abuse and illicit drug use.
labels.review_notes: Drug-abuse screening performed is not equivalent to a positive or negative illicit-drug-use result.

labels.criterion_text: Participation in a clinical trial in the year prior to this study;
labels.reason: The source record has no explicit information confirming or excluding participation in another clinical trial during the year before the relevant study entry.
missing_information: Clinical-trial participation history covering the one-year window before study entry.
labels.review_notes: Historical snapshot reference date is 2021-11-30; the actual planned study entry date is not supplied.

labels.criterion_text: Pregnancy or risk of pregnacy and lactating participants;
labels.reason: In this synthetic retrospective screening benchmark, the recorded 62-year-old male demographics are treated as not triggering the trial’s pregnancy/lactation-only exclusion; no additional reproductive-planning clause is present.
labels.review_notes: Confirmed E02 synthetic-data demographic convention: recorded male gender and age 62 are treated as non-applicability for this pregnancy/lactation-only exclusion. This is a retrospective benchmark convention, NOT a universal clinical determination of pregnancy potential. E01 exc_013 also includes planning to have a baby, so remains UNKNOWN.

labels.criterion_text: Known hypersensitivity to any of the formula compounds;
labels.reason: No affirmative hypersensitivity history or explicit, complete negative allergy history to each formula component is documented. The formula compound list is not established by the supplied patient facts.
missing_information: Positive or comprehensive negative hypersensitivity evidence for relevant compounds.
labels.review_notes: Absence of an AllergyIntolerance entry in the normalized source data is not evidence of no allergy.

labels.reason: A confirmed type 2 diabetes-associated neuropathy diagnosis supports T2D, but the record does not independently establish whether a type 1 diabetes diagnosis exists or is explicitly absent.
missing_information: Explicit type 1 diabetes status, or a sufficiently scoped negative diagnosis assessment.
labels.review_notes: Consistent with E01 exc_004: positive T2D evidence is not treated as an explicit negative T1D statement.
